title: Implement worker-startup processing recovery

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Worker recovery tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_worker_recovery.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#startup-recovery RED: startup cannot atomically recover the durable processing population or publish truthful recovery facts; GREEN: a controlled mixed population resets every processing row to pending, preserves pending/terminal rows, clears stale operation and records exact worker/recovery timestamps and count; decisive comparison: complete before/after row identity and singleton projection match with no loss; artifact: isolated recovery transaction timeline.
purpose: Provide one atomic processing-owned startup recovery transaction before the worker loop runs.
success_outcome: Startup returns every unfinished processing row to pending, preserves queued/terminal rows and records one truthful recovery projection.
anti_goals: Do not start the long-running loop, replay inference or add leases, recovery jobs, history or per-row recovery state.
Do not reset ready, no_faces, failed or already pending rows.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: Recovery cannot be one bounded owner transaction over existing state.
Correct recovery would require another queue, per-row recovery lifecycle or foreign state mutation.

constraints: Run once during configured worker startup before any new claim.
Use a controlled known population, repeat-safe fixture and owner-bounded cleanup.
Record worker_started_at, last_recovery_at and last_recovered_count without history.
invariants: Every processing row returns to pending and no queued row is lost.
Terminal and already-pending rows keep their outcome/state.
Recovery clears the stale operation and creates no work replay.
verification_targets: Controlled before/after population proves exact reset, timestamps/count and safe repeat in disposable PostgreSQL state.
